name: AVENOL, Joseph Louis Anne Marie Charles

details.summary: French international financial expert and second Secretary-General of the League of Nations 1933-1940
details.life: Was born 9 June 1879 in Melle, Deux-Sèvres, France, and passed away 2 September 1952 in Duillier, Vaud, Switzerland. He was the son of Ernest Joseph Marie Avenol, Swiss Guard member and solicitor, and Marie Françoise Renée Dehansy. On 4 September 1901 he married Marie Louise Jeanne Catherine Bernadette Emma (known as Jeanne) Maurel.
